title: Particle Sandbox
prompt:
Build a falling-sand sandbox on a grid of at least 80x60 cells with sand, water and wall. Each tick, bottom row first: sand moves down into an empty or water cell (swapping with water), else diagonally down (seeded left/right choice); water moves down, else diagonally down, else one cell sideways; walls never move; the grid edges are solid. The simulation never creates or destroys particles. Mouse or finger painting applies immediately in the event handler with radius 2 and the selected material ('empty' erases); sand and water only fill empty cells. Keyboard: Digit1 sand, Digit2 water, Digit3 wall, Digit4 eraser, Space pause.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score (particles), cols, rows, material:'sand'|'water'|'wall'|'empty', paused, counts:{sand, water, wall}}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.selectMaterial(name): choose the paint material
- Game.input.paint(x, y, radius): fill the cells within radius (0 = one cell)
- Game.input.togglePause(): while paused step() changes nothing
- Game.getCell(x, y): 'empty', 'sand', 'water' or 'wall'
- Game.clear(): empty the grid
- Game.cellCenter(x, y): canvas point of a cell

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): falling, piling, walls, water levelling, sinking, conservation, pause, clear, seeded runs, painting, keys.
